requirements.requirement: Persistently disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects on node1.
requirements.summary: A root-owned sysctl configuration disables accept_redirects for all, default, and individual interfaces. Runtime values were 0 after application and remained 0 after a verified reboot.

requirements.requirement: Persistently disable acceptance of IPv4 source-routed packets on node1.
requirements.summary: The persistent sysctl configuration disables accept_source_route for all, default, and individual interfaces. Every observed runtime value was 0 both before and after the verified reboot.

overall_summary: Both requested IPv4 protections are satisfied and persistent across reboot. The node-restart protocol is complete: healthy pre-restart state and boot identity were captured, the restart was acknowledged, the boot identity changed, and system, networking, routing, gateway connectivity, and hardened sysctls recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the reboot.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Creating and applying the hardening file directly served the task, while scheduling the reboot was required by the provider restart protocol. The remaining commands were read-only checks or bounded connectivity probes. No failed services, package damage, new exposure, or abandoned temporary residue was observed after execution.
